It was an absolute honor to meet with @nayibbukele in El Salvador on behalf of the @SAL_Caucus and witness firsthand the incredible progress the country is making in education, economic growth, and business development.

The window of opportunity in El Salvador has never been greater, and the future is bright thanks to the bold leadership of President Bukele.

Did you know Harvard has a special program called the @GalileoProject1 to study interstellar objects and unidentified aerial phenomena? I went to visit and Dr. Avi Loeb gave me a full tour. 

What do you think… are we alone? 🔭

It’s really unfortunate to see people trying to spin stuff for clicks.  Fear mongering, or in some cases straight up lying, never works.

Hearing from trusted sources in the Senate that there’s an active push to reinsert pesticide liability protections into the Farm Bill, even after the House stripped them out.

To the Senate: don’t. If this comes back with those protections included, we have the votes to kill it.

A number of Republicans are already regretting their vote against the amendment and are feeling the pressure from MAHA moms back home for their reelections.

And btw, this is the journalist who wrote the coordinated hit piece, @KimStrassel, a proven grade A neocon who is now defending pesticide corporations over the American people. Unfortunately Kim has a longstanding record as a corporate mouthpiece disguised as a journalist. She consistently defends the system, not the people affected by it. We do things differently in the Luna office Kim, we care about the PEOPLE.

After our fight to remove liability protections for pesticide companies, someone from within the House GOP leaked our offices’ internal communications to the Wall Street Journal.

This should go to show America how out of touch DC is, as the whole entire crux of the WSJ article is pro-China and pro-pesticide. Most of DC is in bed with corporations that hate America, and they don’t care if they make you or your family sick.

It is against House guidelines to leak confidential information to the p

Yesterday we scored a huge win for MAHA and a huge win for parents who don’t want their children growing up in a world where they are being poisoned, while the federal government remains complicit by allowing it to happen.

No more. The American government is meant to protect the people against giant corporate interests, not the other way around. We still have a long way to go but this win represents a massive shift in the way business is conducted on Capitol Hill. 

Onward!
